name: OHLC Check
summary: This EA is a utility tool that checks and validates OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) data integrity in MetaTrader 5. It compares historical bar data from different sources or timeframes to detect discrepancies, missing bars, or data corruption issues in the price feed.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个实用工具，用于检查和验证MetaTrader 5中OHLC（开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价）数据的完整性。它通过对比不同来源或周期的历史K线数据，检测价格数据中的差异、缺失K线或数据损坏问题。
strategy_analysis: 此EA并非交易策略，而是一个数据验证工具。它的核心功能是逐根K线地读取和比对OHLC数据，检测数据源之间的一致性。入场条件和出场条件不适用于此工具，因为它不执行任何交易操作。仓位管理和资金管理同样不适用。其主要逻辑包括遍历指定范围内的历史K线，对比不同数据源的价格值，标记出不一致的数据点，并以日志或图表的方式输出检测结果。工具可能还包含对时间戳连续性的检查，以发现缺失的K线时段。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but rather a data validation utility tool. Its core function is to read and compare OHLC data bar by bar, checking consistency between data sources. Entry and exit conditions are not applicable since it does not execute any trading operations. Position sizing and money management are likewise not applicable. Its main logic involves iterating through historical bars within a specified range, comparing price values from different data sources, flagging inconsistent data points, and outputting detection results via logs or charts. The tool may also include timestamp continuity checks to discover missing bar periods.

parameters.name: CheckPeriod
parameters.description: 需要检查的历史K线数量
parameters.description_en: Number of historical bars to check

parameters.name: AlertOnDiscrepancy
parameters.description: 发现数据差异时是否弹出警报

pros: 帮助交易者发现数据源中的异常，避免因错误数据导致交易决策失误
可以系统化地验证大量历史数据的完整性，比人工检查效率高得多
作为调试和诊断工具，能有效排查回测结果与实盘表现不一致的数据层面原因
pros_en: Helps traders detect anomalies in data sources, avoiding trading decisions based on faulty price data
Systematically validates integrity of large volumes of historical data, far more efficient than manual checks
Serves as a debugging and diagnostic tool, effectively isolating data-level causes when backtest results diverge from live performance
cons: 仅提供数据检查功能，不参与任何交易，功能范围较为单一
对于数据差异的判断标准可能不够灵活，难以适应所有数据源的特殊情况
缺乏图形化界面展示结果，仅依赖日志输出不够直观
cons_en: Only provides data checking functionality with no trading capability, making its feature set quite narrow
The criteria for judging data discrepancies may not be flexible enough to accommodate all special cases across different data sources
Lacks a graphical interface for presenting results; relying solely on log output is not intuitive enough
improvements: 增加图形化面板，以图表形式直观展示数据差异的位置和程度
增加自动修复或剔除异常数据的功能选项，并支持导出验证报告
improvements_en: Add a graphical panel to visually display the location and magnitude of data discrepancies in chart form
Add options for automatically repairing or excluding anomalous data, and support exporting validation reports

risk_points: 该工具不执行任何交易操作，不存在资金风险
如果数据检查逻辑本身存在缺陷，可能产生误报或漏报，误导交易者判断
risk_points_en: This tool does not execute any trading operations, so there is no financial risk
If the data checking logic itself has flaws, it may produce false positives or false negatives, misleading traders' judgment

summary_en: This EA is a utility tool that checks and validates OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) data integrity in MetaTrader 5. It compares historical bar data from different sources or timeframes to detect discrepancies, missing bars, or data corruption issues in the price feed.
